title: Portal schema relationships
description: An asset has zero or more service requests, and a customer user submits zero or more service requests; each request names one asset and one submitter. A service request has zero or more attachments and one or more outbox records. The request holds the scoped submission key and payload hash. All keys include the tenant.

nodes.label: Asset
nodes.detail: PK tenant + asset; cached from ERP

nodes.label: Customer user
nodes.detail: PK tenant + user; identity from the identity provider

nodes.label: ServiceRequest
nodes.detail: PK tenant + submission ID; FK tenant + asset; unique tenant + submitter + submission key; payload hash

nodes.label: Attachment
nodes.detail: FK tenant + submission ID; object key; scan state

nodes.label: Outbox
nodes.detail: PK event; FK tenant + submission ID; handoff state, attempts
